name: Kota Bharu
ai_name: Kota Bharu town centre, Kelantan, Malaysia, beside Sungai Kelantan
council: Majlis Perbandaran Kota Bharu - Bandar Raya Islam (MPKB-BRI)

notes.businesses: Shops, eateries and pharmacies as mapped on OpenStreetMap (fetched 3 Oct 2026). The list is what volunteers have mapped, not checked on the ground, so many real businesses are missing and some listed ones may have closed.
notes.shelters: No relief centre list from an official or public source has been collected for this area, so none are shown.
notes.history: Dated floods that sources say reached this town centre, from news and official reports checked on 3 Oct 2026 (details and every source opened: the project's raw-data notes). Not a complete record.
notes.depths: Depth check: the model puts more than 5 m of water at 53 of these businesses in a 1 in 100 years flood, but news reports of real floods in the town give about 0.25 to 2 m. The model runs deep beside the river here: read its depths as the model's, not as what to expect.

floods.what: The river flood covered the town, including Jalan Tok Hakim, Jalan Hamzah and Jalan Temenggong. One shop's stock was under water at waist level.
floods.source: Berita Harian, 24 Dec 2014; Malay Mail, 29 and 30 Dec 2014

floods.what: Sungai Kelantan spilled into the town centre and most roads there went under water. Reported depths differ: 0.25 to 0.3 m as it began, and about 2 m later that day, from the state police chief.
Flash flood around Jalan Hilir Pasar after hours of heavy rain, blamed on blocked drains. It had gone by the afternoon.
floods.source: Kosmo, 2 Apr 2025; Harian Metro, 2 Apr 2025; Berita Harian, 2 Apr 2025
